name: ck_validate
description: Validate code, config, shell commands, or text against ControlKeel's 6-layer deterministic scanner (pattern rules, entropy detection, destructive-shell tripwires, trust-boundary checks, security-workflow phases, optional Semgrep). Runs in ~50ms with zero LLM tokens. Returns allow/warn/block with findings and auto-fix suggestions. Call BEFORE writing files or running commands.

content.description: Content to validate: source code, config, shell command, or text.

name: ck_context
description: Get full governed session state: active findings, budget, tasks, memory hits, proof summary, improvement loop, autonomy profile, workspace context. Call at start of every task.

name: ck_budget
description: Check remaining budget, spend history, session limits. CK tracks per-invocation cost with circuit breakers.

name: ck_submit_review
description: Submit plan, diff, or completion for human review. Creates review gate in Mission Control. Plans must be approved before execution proceeds.

name: ck_record_finding
description: Record a governance finding with severity, category, and ruling. Use when you discover issues the scanner missed.

name: ck_memory_record
description: Save durable memory that survives sessions. Typed records with citations for decisions, findings, checkpoints.

name: ck_memory_search
description: Search governed memory for prior decisions, findings, proofs. Embedding-based semantic search.

name: ck_generate_proof
description: Generate immutable proof bundle: findings, reviews, validation evidence, verification score. The ship-ready audit artifact.

name: ck_complete_task
description: Mark task done. BLOCKED if unresolved findings exist. Generates proof bundle automatically.
